answer: An economy can price identities in sequential time. After each epoch's public beacon, every account must post a delay-function output seeded by its own key and that beacon: ten minutes of strictly serial computation, checked in milliseconds. An honest agent pays once. A farm of N fakes must run N chains in the same window, so its hardware bill climbs linearly with N. Rewards are the nectar, the delay is the ledge each account must climb, and an account that skips it drifts out of the payout set like dune sand.
